title: 第十三章 道骨仁心第十四章 天下熙熙
content_zh:
回春术：小成。
周无纪看着北帝天刑书上的标注，感觉非常不错。
投入了两个人的命格，就把回春术从入门提升到小成层次。
很明显，回春术比潇湘剑法差很多很多。
就是如此，要没有北帝天刑书加持，他修炼一辈子也未必能把回春术练到小成境界。
毕竟人的精力有限，哪怕一天练一个时辰回春术，一年下来真正修炼的时间也只有一个月。
北帝天刑书加持的本源玄灵，却能让他心无旁骛的长时间修炼。
这种修炼方式又非常奇妙，明明时间很长却不会让他疲倦，总能保持极其专注的修炼状态。
周无纪每次使用北帝天刑书，都要感叹此书的神妙，不愧是道门第一杀伐神器！
北帝天刑书强大神妙，却戒律森严。他师父就是受到戒律限制，一直没有太大成就。
他能进步这么快，就是能避开戒律的约束。
否则的话，单是开坛祷告祭拜，就不知要多少时间花多少的钱。
开坛也有诸多讲究，不是想开就能开的。
周无纪觉得自己和北帝天刑书简直是天生一对，尽得其利又能尽避其害。
他想到这里是愈发得意，再看北帝天刑书是怎么看怎么喜欢。
书页上还剩余八人命格，都是二两以下贱命……
就是都投入回春术，也不足以让回春术升级。
升级金光术，又有些浪费。
周无纪觉得还是暂时留着，贱命也是命，不能浪费。
忙乎了半宿，周无纪也有点累了。

他想洗漱休息，只是船上却找不到热水。他本想胡乱凑合一下，却看到李信匆忙过来。
“道长、李强情况很不好，请您给看看。”李信说着连连躬身作揖，态度异常诚恳也异常谦卑。
李信刚才忙乎了半天，帮着收拾了乱兵尸体。
一共十四个全甲乱兵，都是咽喉中剑而死。他虽然不会武技，却还是有些见识，知道这样剑法非常恐怖非常强大。
以往他对周无纪客气，也只是看着一元道人面子礼貌性的客气，再就是他性子圆滑，谁都不愿意得罪。
经过这一战，李信对周无纪的看法却彻底改变了。
这个被众人视为无能的年轻道人，真实本领强得可怕。更可怕是这人心思深沉，有本事却不显露。
杀了一众乱兵，也没有得意炫耀，更没有畏惧不安，从始至终都是平静如水。
李信也见过不少大人物，若论城府之深，这年轻人真是数一数二。
面对如此可怕高手，李信不止是尊敬，更是打心里畏惧。
“哦，我看看。”
周无纪才练好了回春术，正想找人试试手。
李信听到周无纪愿意帮忙，顿时满脸喜色连连鞠躬。他也不敢多说什么，引着周无纪去了岸上。
强壮的李强就躺在树下避风处，地上铺了一张竹席，身上还盖了薄被。
旁边点燃火堆火光摇曳，李强紧闭着眼睛脸色煞白，浑身微微颤抖抽搐，显得情况很是不妙。
几个伙计围在一旁，都是满脸的焦急之色。
之前他们在惊惶中扔下李强不管，却都是吓坏了，其实他们和李强关系都不错。
眼见李强情况不妙，都很为他着急。
就算平素关系不好，这会也不会在脸上显露出来。
周无纪凑到近前，就看到李强嘴唇都是乌青，呼吸虚弱。

掀开被子，李强肩膀箭已经被取掉，伤口上了药包扎好，只是布带已经透出乌黑血迹。
content_en:
Rejuvenation: Small success.
Zhou Wuji looked at the markings on the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book and felt very good.
By investing two people's fates, the art of rejuvenation has been upgraded from beginner to master level.
Obviously, the Rejuvenation Technique is much, much worse than the Xiaoxiang Sword Technique.
That's it. Without the blessing of Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book, he may not be able to practice the rejuvenation technique to a small level after practicing for a lifetime.
After all, people's energy is limited. Even if you practice rejuvenation for an hour a day, you will only have one month of real practice in a year.
The original mysterious spirit blessed by Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book allowed him to practice for a long time without any distractions.
This method of cultivation is very wonderful. Even though it takes a long time, it does not make him tired, and he can always maintain an extremely focused cultivation state.
Every time Zhou Wuji used the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book, he would sigh at the wonder of this book. It was indeed the Taoist sect's number one killing artifact!
Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book is powerful and magical, but has strict rules. His master was restricted by the precepts and had never achieved much.
He can progress so quickly because he can avoid the constraints of the commandments.
Otherwise, just opening an altar to pray and worship would take an incredible amount of time and money.
There are a lot of things to pay attention to when opening a forum, and you can’t just open one just because you want to.
Zhou Wuji felt that he and Beidi Tianxingshu were a match made in heaven, and they could both benefit from and avoid harm as much as possible.
He felt even more proud when he thought of this, and he liked it as much as he read the Beidi Tianxing Book.
There are eight lives left on the page, all of which are worth less than two taels...
Even if they all invest in the Rejuvenation Technique, it is not enough to upgrade the Rejuvenation Technique.
Upgrading the golden light technique is a bit wasteful.
Zhou Wuji felt that it was better to keep it for the time being. A life is a life and cannot be wasted.
After working hard for half a night, Zhou Wuji was also a little tired.
He wanted to wash up and rest, but there was no hot water on the boat. He wanted to make do with it, but he saw Li Xin coming in a hurry.
"Taoist Priest, Li Qiang's condition is very bad. Please take a look at it." Li Xin said, bowing repeatedly, his attitude was extremely sincere and humble.
Li Xin had been busy for a long time just now, helping to clean up the corpses of the rebels.
There were a total of fourteen soldiers in full armor, all of whom were killed by swords in their throats. Although he doesn't know martial arts, he still has some knowledge and knows that this kind of sword technique is very terrifying and powerful.
In the past, when he was polite to Zhou Wuji, he was only polite because of Taoist Yiyuan's face. Moreover, he had a smooth temperament and was unwilling to offend anyone.
After this battle, Li Xin's view of Zhou Wuji completely changed.
This young Taoist who was regarded as incompetent by everyone turned out to be terrifyingly powerful. What's even more frightening is that this man has a deep mind and doesn't show his ability even though he has it.
After killing a bunch of rebel soldiers, he didn't show off proudly, let alone feel any fear or anxiety. He was as calm as water from beginning to end.
Li Xin has also met many important people. When it comes to the depth of the city, this young man is really one of the best.
Facing such a terrifying master, Li Xin not only respected him, but also feared him from the bottom of his heart.
"Oh, let me see."
Zhou Wuji had just mastered the rejuvenation technique and was looking for someone to try it out.
When Li Xin heard that Zhou Wuji was willing to help, his face was filled with joy and he bowed repeatedly. He didn't dare to say anything more and led Zhou Wuji to the shore.
The strong Li Qiang lay in a sheltered place under a tree, with a bamboo mat spread on the ground and a thin quilt covering him.
A fire was lit next to him and the flames flickered. Li Qiang closed his eyes tightly and his face turned pale. His whole body was trembling and twitching slightly, which showed that the situation was very bad.
Several guys gathered around, all with anxious expressions on their faces.
They had left Li Qiang in panic before, but they were all frightened. In fact, they had a good relationship with Li Qiang.
Seeing that Li Qiang's condition was not good, they were all worried about him.
Even if the relationship is not good, it will not show on the face.
Zhou Wuji came closer and saw that Li Qiang's lips were blue and his breathing was weak.
Li Qiang lifted the quilt and saw that the arrow on Li Qiang's shoulder had been removed and the wound was bandaged with medicine, but the cloth belt had already revealed black blood.
